generation_runtime.scip_random_seed_shift: SCIP library default; identical for every arm

multiobjective_score_protocol.feasibility: 1 for FEASIBLE, 0 for INFEASIBLE; UNKNOWN is not scored
multiobjective_score_protocol.public_objective: public maximize objective divided by the fixed shared-root absolute-objective scale
multiobjective_score_protocol.negative_cost: negative candidate proposal+evaluation seconds divided by 60 seconds
multiobjective_score_protocol.native_vs_archive: native per-key winners and GEPA-pruned elites are reported separately from the complete non-dominated archive

parent_policy: pareto-only changes only old-population parent selection/order; the original positional default/direct/objective mutation schedule and acceptance checks are unchanged. Direct exploration is ordered into an existing objective slot.
merge_policy: The merge arm alone attempts compatible GEPA merges in non-reserved slots. A tested merge replaces that slot's mutation and consumes one child evaluation but no solver call. Untested attempts fall back to the original mutation.
cost_protocol: Each arm has an independent ledger. The shared root check is charged to each arm ledger; proposal, evaluation, merge, duplicate, and solver-inclusive costs are not shared across arms. Official wall time is added only post-freeze.
expansion_stop_rule: Predeclared stop at two generations or six child evaluations, whichever comes first; also stop on a generation with no new evaluation. Direct-full stops after one. No extra solve is allowed to force direct or merge coverage, and no official result triggers expansion.

prior_baseline.note: Prior baseline is hash-audited but all five arms are rerun under one runtime for this experiment.

summary.note: Official measurements are strictly post-freeze and were never used for parent selection or expansion.
